# Results

<!-- Generated by `python -m ssemd docs` from data/; edit src/ssemd/report.py, not this file. -->

All values are model predictions with un-fine-tuned MACE-MP-0 small at the MP/PBE volume: sigma(300 K) is a Nernst-Einstein conductivity extrapolated to 300 K from an Arrhenius fit (or an upper bound), in mS/cm. Brackets give the pooled 95% interval of multi-seed fits. Rules: [CLASSIFICATION_PROTOCOL.md](CLASSIFICATION_PROTOCOL.md); methods: [methods.md](methods.md); every row comes from [data/classification.csv](../data/classification.csv).

## Classes

| Class | Rule | Compositions |
|---|---|---|
| Fast (validated) | replicate rule passes (or the terminal rule's pooled 95% interval decides) and sigma(300 K) >= 0.1 mS/cm | 11 |
| Slow (measured) | Arrhenius fit over >= 3 eligible temperatures with sigma(300 K) < 0.1 mS/cm | 2 |
| Slow (two-point estimate) | exactly 2 eligible temperatures; two-point sigma(300 K) < 0.1 mS/cm | 6 |
| Slow (upper bound) | fewer than 2 eligible temperatures; upper bound on sigma(300 K) < 0.1 mS/cm | 43 |
| Thermally unstable | framework not intact at any tested temperature down to 400 K | 0 |

## Sensitivity and audit

- **Prefactor.** With D0,min = 1e-5 cm2/s instead of 1e-4, Li2SiSnS4 is no longer below the threshold (bound 0.547 mS/cm). Fitted D0 over the 19 compositions with >= 2 eligible temperatures: minimum 1.23e-4 cm2/s (Li6AsS5I), median 0.00522 cm2/s.
- **Failed kinisi fits (amendment A3.2).** Excluded runs: Li5P(S2Cl)2 450K_seed3; Rb2LiTaS4 1000K_seed0; Li7Y7ZrS16 1000K_seed0; Li6AsS5I 700K_seed3; Li2CdGeS4 1000K_seed0; Li2GePbS4 800K_seed0; Li10Zn7(PS4)8 450K_seed1, 525K_seed4; Cs2LiNbS4 1000K_seed0. Class changes: Li5P(S2Cl)2 (Fast (validated) with the rule, Slow (measured) without); Li2GePbS4 (Slow (upper bound) with the rule, Slow (two-point estimate) without); Li10Zn7(PS4)8 (Fast (validated) with the rule, Slow (measured) without).
- **Near the threshold.** Pooled 95% interval contains 0.1 mS/cm: Li6AsS5I, Li3BiS3.

## From the seed-0 census to the classes

The census labelled a composition by its worst temperature; the protocol replaced that veto by per-temperature eligibility. Census labels are kept as evidence only.

| Census outcome | Fast (validated) | Slow (measured) | Slow (two-point estimate) | Slow (upper bound) | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Census lead (conditional) | 4 | 1 | . | . | 5 |
| Census lead (review) | . | 1 | . | . | 1 |
| Unresolved diffusion | . | . | . | 36 | 36 |
| Framework melting at 800/1000 K | 7 | . | 1 | 2 | 10 |
| Unresolved and melting | . | . | . | 3 | 3 |
| Undetermined at 600 K | . | . | 5 | 2 | 7 |
